title: ASIC Design Verification Engineer  - 5 years to 13Years - Bangalore
teaser: Join our team as a ASIC Design Verification Engineer, where you will develop and execute verification strategies for complex hardware designs, focusing on emulation platforms. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure the correctness and performance of ASICs. Ideal for candidates with significant experience in design verification and a strong background in test methodologies.
description:
Meet the Team:

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. We craft the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by crafting, developing and testing some of the most sophisticated ASICs being developed in the industry. You will engage in dynamic collaboration with verification engineers, designers, and multi-functional teams, working together to ensure the successful verification of the ASIC throughout its lifecycle.

Your Impact

As a Design Verification Engineer specializing in Emulation, you will be responsible for developing and executing verification strategies to ensure the correctness and performance of complex hardware designs. Your primary focus will be on emulation platforms to accelerate verification cycles and improve coverage.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement verification plans and test benches using emulation tools and methodologies.

Collaborate with design and validation teams to identify verification requirements and coverage goals.

Utilize emulation platforms to run large-scale verification tests and debug design issues.

Analyze verification results, identify bugs, and work closely with design engineers to resolve issues.

Maintain and enhance verification infrastructure and automation frameworks.

Document verification processes, test cases, and results to ensure traceability and reproducibility.

Stay current with emerging verification technologies and best practices, particularly in emulation.

Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelors + 7 years of related experience, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience Preferred Qualifications Varies based on the team and business needs | Preferred Qualifications are desired education, experience, and skills that are in addition to Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications include:

Relevant experience in design verification with a strong emphasis Test Methodologies
